predecessors.name: Weimar Republic
predecessors.text: the Free City proper: the city of Danzig, Zoppot, Oliva, Tiegenhof, Neuteich and some 252 villages, 1,952 km2 in 1928

successors.name: Nazi Germany
successors.text: the Free City proper: the city of Danzig, Zoppot, Oliva, Tiegenhof, Neuteich and some 252 villages, 1,952 km2 in 1928

ledger.x: 15 November 1920: the Free City of Danzig is established.
1 September 1939: Germany annexes the Free City.
1939: the Free City ends in the Reichsgau Danzig-West Prussia.

wars.name: Invasion of Poland
wars.outcome: The Free City was annexed by Germany on 1 September 1939, the day of the invasion; no border changed before that date.

certainty.note: The frontier was fixed under Article 100 of the Treaty of Versailles and the page gives an exact area (1,952 km2, 1928) and the districts; the outline is Cliopatria's coarse 1936 shape.
